# Instrument samples

These 69 MP3 files are an unchanged subset of **tonejs-instruments** by
**Nicholas Brosowsky**, distributed under [CC BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).

- [Source repository](https://github.com/nbrosowsky/tonejs-instruments)
- [Pinned distributor license statement](https://github.com/nbrosowsky/tonejs-instruments/blob/622c2f1c32c8cfce4158ddc3eb26e518ddef37e5/README.md#license)
- [Original-source list](https://github.com/nbrosowsky/tonejs-instruments/blob/622c2f1c32c8cfce4158ddc3eb26e518ddef37e5/sample-source-info.txt)

| Included files | Original recording source named by the distributor |
| --- | --- |
| 36 guitar-acoustic files | University of Iowa Electronic Music Studios (Lawrence Fritts), http://theremin.music.uiowa.edu/ |
| 16 bass-electric files | Karoryfer Samples, https://shop.karoryfer.com/pages/free-samples |
| 17 guitar-electric files | Karoryfer Samples, https://shop.karoryfer.com/pages/free-samples |

The distributor describes its edits as silence trimming, fades, volume matching,
normalization, noise removal and some pitch correction. RS Studio does not modify
the supplied files; it includes a subset and pitch-shifts them during playback.

Karoryfer's official free-samples page states that all its free libraries are now
CC0, including older downloads with more restrictive notices (except the unrelated
Marie Ork voice bank). The distributor does not name the exact original Karoryfer
libraries, so we retain its CC BY 3.0 statement for these edited distribution files.
No endorsement by the recording authors or distributor is implied.

## File verification

All 69 files match the distributor's Git blob hashes at commit
`622c2f1c32c8cfce4158ddc3eb26e518ddef37e5`. SHA-256 checksums of the included files are in
[sample-checksums.json](sample-checksums.json).
